defs.def: to risk money on a race or an event by trying to predict the result 下赌注（于）；用 … 打赌

ex.s: I bet you’re as eager as I am to find out just how many have been motivated enough to last the full seven days!
ex.t: 我敢打赌你跟我一样迫切想知道到底有多少人有了足够的动力坚持了整整七天！

ex.s: B: I think she must be an honest person because … A: I bet she’s really determined too.
ex.t: B：我觉得她一定是个诚实的人，因为…… A：我打赌她一定也很坚定。

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．
ex.t: 他已经53岁了，他的成年生活大多是债务和不幸的失败。战争的伤害使他的左手停止了运转，他经常在监狱里。由于天知道什么动机，他决定写一本书。

defs.def: an arrangement to risk money, etc. on the result of a particular event; the money that you risk in this way 打赌；赌注

ex.s: Dandan noodles and mapo tofu are sure bets.
ex.t: 担担面和麻婆豆腐是绝对不会踩雷的选择。

ex.s: THE MILLION POUND BANK NOTE ACT 1, SCENE 3 Read about a bet between two wealthy men 1 What would you do if you had a million-pound bank note?
ex.t: 《百万英镑》 第一幕 第三场 阅读关于两个富人的一个赌注 1 如果你有一张百万英镑的钞票，你会怎么做？

defs.def: an opinion about what is likely to happen or to have happened 预计；估计

ex.s: Two rich brothers, Roderick and Oliver, have made a bet.
ex.t: 两个富有的兄弟，罗德里克和奥利弗，打了一个赌。

ex.s: Narrator: 1 What bet did Roderick and Oliver make?
ex.t: 旁白： 1 罗德里克和奥利弗打了什么赌？
